derivation_reference_gauge.name: synchronous
derivation_reference_gauge.boundary: Gauge choice is a representation convention, not a physical claim. CLASS and CAMB mappings must be implemented and tested independently.

primary_candidate_variables.reason: momentum-density variable remains primary when 1+w_s approaches zero

derived_variables.allowed_when: rho_s+p_s is demonstrably nonzero and numerically conditioned
derived_variables.boundary: not a primary evolution variable near enthalpy degeneracy

regularity_invariants: no naked division by 1+w_s in primary evolution equations
no epsilon clipping may be used to manufacture regularity
rho_s+p_s = -(1/3) d rho_s / d ln(a) must hold for the separately conserved candidate
theta_s reconstruction may be diagnostic only where enthalpy is sufficiently nonzero
analytic limiting equations must be derived before CLASS/CAMB implementation

diagnostics.rule: thresholds classify numerical conditioning only; they do not alter equations or clip variables

next_gate: derive conservation equations directly in (delta_rho_s,q_s) in the frozen reference gauge, derive the enthalpy-degenerate limit analytically, then derive super-horizon IC and independent CLASS/CAMB mappings
rollback: Revert this regular-variable contract only; retain A1.1 necessary-gate evidence and reopen C07/C08.
